calls.head: The Mammoth are going to test the Blackhawks’ goalie early and often
calls.body: The Mammoth shoot a lot, and the Blackhawks are one of the league’s worst at keeping shots down. Look for a big shot total.
calls.call: The Mammoth take at least their usual 60.3 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5.
calls.nums: Utah 5th for shot volume (60.3 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5) · Chicago 29th for shot suppression
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 0 and 1 games this season
calls.happened: Utah took 73.5 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5 (adjusted for score and venue), against their usual 60.3.

calls.head: In close against from distance
calls.body: The Mammoth are around the middle of the league for shots from in close, at the close-range end; the Blackhawks are the league’s worst, at the long-range end. Expect that gap to show.
calls.call: The Mammoth take a bigger share of their shots from within 20 feet than the Blackhawks.
calls.nums: Shots from in close: Utah 11th, Chicago 32nd
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 1 and 0 games this season
calls.happened: On share of 5-on-5 shots from within 20 feet, Utah had 35% and Chicago 11%. Coming in, Utah was at 31% and Chicago at 27%.

UTA.head: We gave Utah a 67% chance, and Utah delivered.

CHI.head: We gave Chicago only a 33% chance, and it went the way we feared.

surprises.head: Utah brought the hits
surprises.body: Utah’s hit score in the close stretches of the game was 204, against their usual 93 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). A team strays this far about once every 200 games.

story.head: Vejmelka shuts out the Blackhawks
paras: Dylan Guenther scored twice, opening the scoring late in the first. Five different Mammoth scored. Karel Vejmelka stopped all 15 shots.
The score was fair. Replay this game’s chances a hundred times and the Mammoth win nine in ten.

items.text: Bowen Byram faces his old team, Buffalo, on Saturday.
Both of the preview’s calls held.
